svg.title: Autosome-set nomenclature
svg.desc: Four conditions in reading order: Haploid (N), A; Diploid (2N), AA; Triploid (3N), AAA; Tetraploid (4N), AAAA. Each has one, two, three, or four separate copies of a red medium-length chromosome with a low centromere, a purple long chromosome with a high centromere, and a yellow short chromosome with a middle centromere. Totals are 3, 6, 9, and 12 unreplicated chromosomes. This is a schematic comparison of generic autosome sets; proportions are illustrative.
